import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=50)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Physical Activity Level distribution by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
box_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == category]['Physical Activity Level'] for category in bmi_order]
axes[0, 1].boxplot(box_data, labels=bmi_order, patch_artist=True,
                   boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Daily Steps': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 2].bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, 
               label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 2].bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, 
               label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightcoral', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 2].bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Daily Steps']/1000, width, 
               label='Daily Steps (thousands)', color='lightgreen', alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Values', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Top 10 Occupations by Sleep Duration', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                  'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols, fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", 
                               color="white" if abs(corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]) > 0.5 else "black",
                               fontsize=8)

# 5. Age distribution by Sleep Disorder
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    disorder_order = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique()
    violin_data = [sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]['Age'] 
                   for disorder in disorder_order]
    
    violin_parts = axes[1, 1].violinplot(violin_data, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in violin_parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('lightsteelblue')
        pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    
    axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 1].set_xticks(np.arange(1, len(disorder_order) + 1))
    axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(disorder_order, rotation=45, ha='right')
else:
    axes[1, 1].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data Available', 
                    ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Stress Level vs Heart Rate by Gender
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 2].scatter(gender_data['Stress Level'], gender_data['Heart Rate'], 
                       alpha=0.6, s=40, label=gender)
    
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].legend()
axes[1, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
